blocks.text: In a fast-evolving media landscape shaped by screen fatigue and changing audience expectations, M360° PR+Activations is setting a new industry benchmark by putting PR in Motion. The integrated communications powerhouse is celebrating a milestone 2026 run—stacking major regional and global accolades, expanding its full-scope client roster with new partners like Yale Home Philippines, and laying the groundwork for its upcoming expansion across key Asian markets including Singapore. The agency’s momentum reflects a sustained track record of excellence.
